name: Sunken Crypt
author: voodoo573
description: A flagstone burial hall entered by stairs from the west. Six stone sarcophagi sit between two rows of pillars, rubble litters the floor, and a candle-lit alcove to the east holds a gilded reliquary. 22 x 16 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Stone crypt hall with sarcophagi, pillars and a reliquary alcove.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
